title: Cabaletta Bio to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: Cabaletta Bio to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
body_markdown:
[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_cb1c59064339e55760c002dd46f1aa03/cabalettabio/news/2026-11-03_Cabaletta_Bio_to_Participate_in_Upcoming_Investor__153.pdf) November 03, 2026 8:00am EST


PHILADELPHIA, Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Cabaletta Bio, Inc. (Nasdaq: CABA), a late-stage clinical biotechnology company focused on developing and launching curative targeted cell therapies designed specifically for patients with autoimmune diseases, today announced its participation in the following upcoming investor conferences:


- **Guggenheim’s 3rd Annual Healthcare Innovation Conference:** Meetings with investors and a webcasted fireside chat at 9:00 a.m. ET on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, in Boston, MA.


- **2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London:** Meetings with investors and a webcasted fireside chat at 5:00 p.m. GMT (12:00 p.m. ET) on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, in London, UK.


The webcasted fireside chats will be accessible on the News and Events section of the Company’s website at[www.cabalettabio.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Q8mGz4etwwxtc_BCbbgjBqlsqfz08a3HaEhBTnmaZW0GA5Xh2cQ-vHwcV5O4rvLt3QSZfw4_GvXm5hHe3SLKivoV7bWOpm5osR44EQ0iyCo=) . Archived replays will be available for 30 days.


**About Cabaletta Bio**
Cabaletta Bio (Nasdaq: CABA) is a late-stage clinical biotechnology company focused on developing and launching curative targeted cell therapies designed specifically for patients with autoimmune diseases. Cabaletta’s lead product candidate, rese-cel, is an investigational 4-1BB-containing fully human CD19-CAR T cell therapy being advanced across the RESET™ (REstoring SElf-Tolerance) clinical development program spanning multiple therapeutic areas, including rheumatology, neurology, and dermatology. Cabaletta Bio’s headquarters and labs are located in Philadelphia, PA. For more information, visit[www.cabalettabio.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Q8mGz4etwwxtc_BCbbgjBqlsqfz08a3HaEhBTnmaZW3-DGFUT_L4QADxBnGjtEHunj8AWUbDtCPWbKsQZC5dx9A2eodr4Ya1CSDKh3OCUoI=) and connect with us on LinkedIn.
